title: Rough terrain fork lift trucks - Code of practice for safety, Part 1: Application, operation and maintenance
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard defines safety requirements relating to application, operation and maintenance of rough terrain fork lift trucks. 1.2 This standard does not cover vehicles intended primarily for earth moving or over the road hauling.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
